scope: Frozen paper runner exits and trustworthy prospective evidence; this stage does not implement the complete AutoResearch trading-policy activation transport

runner_exit.enabled_for: New explicitly paper positions with a valid frozen entry snapshot, after an executed partial and observed peak at least the configured activation threshold
runner_exit.legacy_and_live_behavior: Existing positions without the snapshot and all live positions retain existing exits
guards: The proportional floor is shared by common trailing, dynamic-floor and emergency-giveback checks so a fixed profit-point rule cannot preempt it
Total-PnL protections, stop loss and liquidity protections remain active
Liquidity-crush checks remain active throughout an extended runner holding period
Missing or invalid prices do not extend the no-price timeout
Extension is bounded by the frozen timer; short-lived probes and deep-reversal scalps are excluded
Invalid settings disable the new policy without crashing a buy
Snapshot persists in paper portfolio, buy response, SQL Position and close telemetry; schema upgrade is idempotent and leaves old rows unchanged
runner_exit.limitation: These defaults are bounded paper experiment settings, not optimized or prospectively proven parameters. Price drawdown protection cannot guarantee net proceeds or a fill.

checks: Finite positive committed notional and amount, finite estimated fees, integral fill counts and zero remaining quantity
Net USD equals gross USD minus fees; net percentage equals net USD divided by committed notional
Frozen fee per fill agrees with total estimated SOL fees; recorded total SOL proceeds agree with net SOL when present
Exact-size quote input, output quantity after entry slippage, observed impact bound, raw SPL quantity basis and reverse-quote close distinguish quote-backed estimates from synthetic prices
Terminal trades are keyed by case-sensitive mint and open time; repeat entries are preserved and duplicate copies do not count as additional trades
Terminal closes supersede stale open snapshots; contradictory costed copies are rejected
Run/profile/config identity and prospective open/close times exclude unrelated, future, test and live observations
Observed duration starts at the first selected trade, not wall time elapsed while stopped
Freshness and deterministic token-cluster bootstrap diagnostics supplement the existing normal-approximation diagnostic

latest_runtime_read_only_check.qualification: This is the latest recorded runtime identity, not a replacement for the historical July trading-opportunity audit and not evidence of profitable execution

limitations: Quote-backed paper estimates do not prove live fills, future liquidity or realized live fees
Both uncertainty bounds are diagnostics; token grouping does not remove market-regime or time dependence
Observed token peaks are not cash returns; runner capture uses the actual costed net return denominator

autoresearch_integrity.baseline_capture: Pinned to the existing runtime start and source profile instead of the newly created experiment timestamp
autoresearch_integrity.supplied_metric_qualification: Diagnostic only, automation_eligible=false, with a mandatory finite positive net-PnL check
autoresearch_integrity.demotion: Does not demote unapplied profiles based on unrelated cached reports; default applied-policy checks use scoped terminal evidence
autoresearch_integrity.state_writes: Atomic replacement, nonfinite values normalized to null, existing forward experiment state cannot be overwritten
autoresearch_integrity.remaining: Actual paper policy application, paired comparable prospective champion/challenger evidence, candidate objective correctness and active-policy rollback are not yet complete

verification.intermediate_full_suite: 947 passed in 70.62s before the final baseline/demotion/observed-window regression additions
verification.first_launch_scope: Isolated schema migration and offline integration regressions, not a newly launched trading stack or real provider certification
verification.publishing_checkout: Clean main...origin/main; this stage has not synchronized, committed or pushed changes

remaining_goal_requirements: Integrate requested exact 0.1 SOL sizing consistently with execution and risk constraints
Complete trading-policy AutoResearch adaptation with prospective comparable net-benefit objectives and active-policy rollback
Synchronize all authorized source changes into the publishing checkout, commit and push without secrets or runtime data
